authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES an execution-remainder join for DR-103 obligations recorded on D-013 (schemas.v2) and D-106 (fixture-corpus.v6). It does not close leftover-design. It does not make D-056 gates 2 or 3 hold. It does not add a DR-G* row. It does not change required-now 26. It does not execute fixtures. It does not author remaining fixtures. It does not decide OD-1. It does not produce a lock. It applies nothing, marks nothing SATISFIED, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
